Team — thanks for the context. I reviewed the CSV and SLA intake form (good work).

Decision: we can accommodate FinSight's pilot request for a two-week SLA exception provided:
- FinSight signs the standard addendum (covers named contacts and temporary routing allowance).
- The exception is time-boxed (max 14 days) and includes an objective rollback trigger.
- StratusCloud approves the NDA/addendum for a named contact OR we accept the partner alias flow.

Operational ask for Jasmine/Vivek: prepare a short FAQ for FinSight that explains what Redwood will and will not route during the pilot (list of services, regions excluded), and include the partner-esc alias as the initial emergency channel. Legal will draft the addendum once FinSight confirms.
